name: Bharatronix HotelCheck
tagline: Front-desk software for Akot's lodges & guest houses
description: HotelCheck is built for small hotels and lodges in Akot and across Akola district — room bookings, walk-in check-ins, daily room status and a printable guest folio. Runs in the browser, works on a cheap laptop, and keeps a night auditor's register without the paperwork.
features: Room calendar with booking & walk-in check-in
Guest ID capture and folio printing
Daily room status: occupied, vacant, cleaning
Works on any browser — no server needed

name: Bharatronix BillingDesk
tagline: GST billing for small shops in under a minute
description: BillingDesk turns any counter into a billing station — GST invoices, quotations, customer ledger and daily cash summary. Made for kirana stores, hardware shops and showrooms that want simple billing without an accountant.
features: Customer ledger with WhatsApp payment reminders
Barcode printing for fast counter billing
Import your item list from Excel

name: Bharatronix StockTrack
tagline: Know exactly what's on your shelf, always
description: StockTrack gives you live inventory across purchases, sales and returns — with low-stock alerts, batch numbers and expiry tracking. Ideal for pharma, FMCG and spare-parts businesses that can't afford a stock-out.
features: Live stock with low-stock & reorder alerts

name: Bharatronix CloudLite
tagline: Your first ERP — simple, affordable, powerful
description: CloudLite gives small businesses the essentials — billing, stock, GST and basic accounting — in a beautifully simple interface. Go live in a single day with guided setup and free onboarding webinars.
features: GST billing & quotations on any device
Go live in 1 day with guided setup

name: Bharatronix DinePOS
tagline: Table-side ordering & KOT for hotels and restaurants
description: DinePOS runs the restaurant inside your hotel — table map, kitchen order tickets, multi-tender billing and menu engineering reports. Built for Akot's dhabas, banquets and pure-veg thali houses as much as city cafés.
features: Table map with live course tracking
KOT printing straight to the kitchen
Split, merge and share bills across tables
UPI, card & cash reconciliation per shift
Online order bridge for Swiggy & Zomato

name: Bharatronix CarePlus
tagline: Clinic management — OPD queue to pharmacy
description: CarePlus runs small hospitals and clinics: OPD token queue, patient history, prescriptions, diagnostics and an in-house pharmacy counter. Everything tied to one patient ID so nothing gets typed twice.

name: Bharatronix FinCore
tagline: Finance & GST accounting that closes books 5× faster
description: FinCore is a GST-native finance engine — automated e-invoicing, bank reconciliation, TDS/TCS, and audit-ready reports. Built with practising CAs so your compliance is always one step ahead of deadlines.
features: Audit trail compliant with MCA rules
Import everything from Tally in minutes

name: Bharatronix PeopleSync
tagline: HR & payroll your employees will actually love
description: From biometric attendance to one-click payroll with PF, ESI and professional tax — PeopleSync automates the entire employee lifecycle. Self-service mobile app, appraisals, and org analytics included.
features: One-click payroll with PF, ESI, PT & LWF

name: Bharatronix RetailOne
tagline: Retail ERP + lightning-fast POS for modern stores
description: RetailOne powers single stores and 500-outlet chains alike — billing in under 2 seconds, unified stock across outlets, loyalty programmes and an omnichannel bridge to your online store. Works offline, syncs when connected.
features: Omnichannel: sync with Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify
Expiry & batch tracking for FMCG / pharma
Daily sales reports on your phone

name: Bharatronix HotelPro Stay
tagline: Complete hotel PMS for independent properties
description: HotelPro Stay is the full property-management system for hotels in Akot, Akola and Nagpur — reservations, housekeeping, rate plans, banquet billing and a night audit that closes the day automatically. Replaces the register, the walkie-talkie and the spreadsheet.
features: Banquet & restaurant charges posted to rooms
Guest history with preferences & repeat stays

name: Bharatronix Vidyapeeth
tagline: School ERP from admission to result
description: Vidyapeeth runs the whole school year — admissions, timetables, attendance, fees, exams and report cards — with a parent portal that sends fee reminders and absence alerts automatically.

name: Bharatronix ManufPro
tagline: Manufacturing ERP — BOM to dispatch on one floor
description: ManufPro plans production with live BOMs, work orders, shop-floor job cards and machine-wise OEE — then ties it all to stores, quality checks and dispatch. Built for SME factories that still run month-end on Tally and whiteboards.
features: Work orders & job cards with QR scanning
Stores: GRN, issue, return & bin location
Live production dashboards on the floor TV

name: Bharatronix HotelPro Enterprise
tagline: Multi-property hospitality suite for hotel groups
description: HotelPro Enterprise connects every property a group owns — Akot, Akola, Nagpur, wherever — into one inventory, one rate strategy and one consolidated ledger. Central reservations, group-level reports, brand-standard housekeeping and a loyalty programme that works across all hotels.
features: Consolidated P&L per property and per brand
SSO, roles & audit trails for chains
